data.name: Untergrund Raceways - Arena
data.detailed_description:
Untergrund Raceways Arena (short: URA) is a kart arena fighter from Vantech Studios, developed in cooperation with the AAP. URA covers a scope that seems somewhat atypical for a first PC game.

  • 26 individual arenas, each differing in concept

  • 1v1 to 50-player modes for variety

  • 40 individual, chaotic items

  • 37–40 characters from the AAP Universe

  • Player-like AI opponents with a high level of skill

  • Configurable item selections, rarities, round lengths, and stats

  • A tournament mode that chains together several random tracks

  • A statistics system to track your successes

  • A fully comprehensive achievement system

  • Fully functional splitscreen for up to 4 players

URA can be picked up without any issues even by newcomers to the AAP Universe and requires no prior knowledge, yet rewards those in the know with secrets and lore references.

Arenas

The arenas in URA range from simple, chaotic coliseums to muddy biker pits and entirely otherworldly dimensions. Some arena names include:

  • Black Squad Arena

  • The Treehouse

  • Hinterrooms

  • Harzuslapu

  • Setagayacrash

  • Temple War

  • A Stickl Vo Daham

Items

The items in URA range from simple wall-bouncing projectiles, shields, and a heap of explosions to gigantic Saashunde and huge, all-consuming blasts. Three examples are listed below:

  • Yeethund: A subspecies of the Seeshunde, fired straight ahead and able to bounce off multiple walls.

  • Barrier Crystal: Pink magic that creates a protective shield around its user, which can also be used as a battering ram.

  • Suitcase Rodrification: An extremely rare suitcase item that unleashes a massive black explosion from the user.

Characters

The characters in URA range from well-known figures like Roy Eastman Codec and Anderson to protagonists such as Suzune Kalari, Jason Black, and Darkwin Dust, all the way to mystical characters like Rodriguez Sanchez and Joker.

AI Opponents

The AI opponents in URA are a particular focus, especially until the multiplayer update, and have been designed according to Vantech principles to be as player-like as possible, offering a real challenge and genuine variety. Though some might call certain item uses "antisocial." At any rate, the focus is on the opponents’ human-like feel, general combat competence, and dynamic navigation. The following features were implemented:

  • Dynamic item awareness for every single item

  • Dynamic random navigation of the arenas

  • Offensive/defensive awareness

  • Human-like aiming behavior

  • Use of the same controls as the player

  • No cheats

Configuration

  • Both the rarity of each individual item and which items can appear at all can be precisely adjusted.

  • Which characters are present in a round can also be freely set.

  • How many points are awarded per hit, as well as how many lives each player has or how long each round lasts, can be adjusted at any time.

  • How many rounds are played per tournament can also be configured.

Modes

The standard game is played across 26 arenas with 12 competitors, of which 1–4 are players. Splitscreen can be used for this. Additionally, there is a 1v1 mode on a simple fixed arena and modes for 3 players up to 50 players on the same enlarged arena.

data.short_description: Untergrund Raceways Arena (kurz: URA) ist ein Kart-Arena-Fighter aus dem Hause Vantech Studios, welcher unter Kooperation mit der AAP (Austrian Anime Productions) entwickelt wird. URA umfasst dabei ein Ausmaß, welches für ein erstes PC-Game etwas untypisch wirkt.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 3100 / Intel Core i3-10100F
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 950 / RX 560
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum specs yield 45-65 fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / RX 570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended specs yield 65+ fps
